overlook.summary: A clubhouse for swimming, fitness and getting together, with membership access for Sterling Ranch households.
highlights: Bring your membership card and enter through the front entrance.
Guests must be accompanied by a resident. Check CAB’s current guest-pass rules before inviting friends.
Clubhouse hours and pool hours are different; use the pool page for the swimming season and schedule.
overlook.note: The CAB rental agreement excludes pool use from facility rentals. Entry guidance describes the published rule; no surveyed entrance point is plotted.

providence-park.summary: The Lawn at Providence sits across from Sterling Center, with a pavilion, picnic tables and walking paths.
highlights: A separate park stop near Sterling Center.
CAB lists walking, biking, picnics, classes and concerts here; check the calendar for a particular event.

prospect-park.note: CAB’s facility listing describes the park and its amenities. Its broader parks overview still contains older construction wording. A pool is not listed as an open amenity; check CAB’s facility page before a visit.

pioneer.access: CAB lists general park hours of 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. Check CAB for current park rules and any closures.
highlights: A large grassy area, playground structure and sun shelter are listed by the official park directories.
The park is among residences on Arapahoe Peak Street.
unknowns: A numbered entrance, parking, restrooms, play age range and accessible route are not specified in the reviewed park listings.
pioneer.note: Official park pages checked September 22, 2026. General CAB park hours are not a guarantee against temporary closures.

burns.address: Pickleball courts: 9020 Middle Fork Street, Sterling Ranch, CO 80125
burns.access: CAB offers pickleball reservations for residents and nonresidents. Check the booking portal for availability and applicable fees.
highlights: The eight pickleball courts are near Sterling Ranch Avenue and Middle Fork Street.
CAB lists free street parking near the courts. Bring paddles and balls and wear court or tennis shoes.
unknowns: Restrooms, accessible routes and the wider park entrance are not specified in the reviewed court sources.
burns.note: These visit details describe the pickleball courts; they do not establish facilities across the wider park.

unknowns: Check same-day availability and weather closures in the official booking portal.
Restrooms and an accessible entrance are not specified in the reviewed court listing.
burns-courts.note: Official CAB pages checked September 22, 2026. The portal and written guidelines describe closing time differently; use the portal for current bookable times and CAB for access rules.
